keyInsight.title: Secondary Research Insight
keyInsight.text: Public vacancy evidence indicates recurring, concentrated demand for manufacturing and technical roles across Coimbatore SME clusters (over 51% in the ₹15k–₹25k bracket). High reported operator attrition and machine downtime support testing a lean, specialized recruitment niche rather than a generic non-technical agency.
